title: [Csharp] Invalid argument count for invoking callable.
body:
### Tested versions

4.3 - mono

### System information

Windows 10 - RTX 4070 - i5 13600kf

### Issue description

Hi, I'm unsure if I should label this as a bug or a feature request in proposals (if it's even technically possible). Also this is a csharp specific issue.

When you create Callable you need to make sure it matches the definition (naturally). But when you miss it the error given by the engine isn't very useful to finding out where the issue stems from, it points to generic stuff in the engine (I take it this is a result of some c# generators?).

Is it possible to provide a better error here or is it out of question, please?
(This isn't caught by IDE since it has no idea what it needs to match the types to.)

Things like this are common with signals and tweens and other interfaces where callables are required.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7d1c748a-bc16-4337-a62d-7f8ca92d7497)

### Steps to reproduce

**(CSharp specific issue so only run with the c# editor build.)**
Play the project, check the debugger error log.
